pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc.
   D. Use Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins? (1 mark)
   A. Say Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

4. Which response best shows understanding of Ijtihad? (1 mark)
   A. Say Ijtihad has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ijtihad.
   C. Use Ijtihad to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Ijtihad with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Secondary sources of Sharia? (1 mark)
   A. Say Secondary sources of Sharia has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Secondary sources of Sharia with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Secondary sources of Sharia to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Secondary sources of Sharia.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

7. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Use Ulum al- Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Hadith.
   C. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Ulum al- Hadith has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf.
   B. Say The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Waste food daily

10. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Founders of Schools of jurisprudence? (1 mark)
   A. Say Founders of Schools of jurisprudence has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Founders of Schools of jurisprudence to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Founders of Schools of jurisprudence.
   D. Apply the teaching of Founders of Schools of jurisprudence with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic Finance? (1 mark)
   A. Use Islamic Finance to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic Finance.
   C. Say Islamic Finance has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Islamic Finance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Secondary sources of Sharia and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Ijtihad and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Founders of Schools of jurisprudence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

2. C — Apply the teaching of Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. C — Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. C — Apply the teaching of The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. D — Apply the teaching of Islamic Finance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Secondary sources of Sharia; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Ijtihad; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Founders of Schools of jurisprudence; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
